judgments.reason: The retained record preserves the same joint indication: film swelling and increased scattering length density indicate water uptake, with the measurement context retained.

Segment 9 links metallic character to increased thermal conductivity. The retained records preserve the thermoelectric benefit but not this separate relationship. Modality or predicate refinement would require local correction, not deletion.
Segment 5 offers a generic claim that structural insight enables rational design, without specifying a concrete design, proposed use, or method outcome beyond the retained structural findings.

Segments 12–13 explicitly jointly link conductivity behavior, thermal stability, and robust electronic structure to proposed device suitability, contextualized by the contact-electrode application. No retained record preserves this joint application rationale.
